notes.title: Bug Fix And Content Update
notes.content:
Hey Players!

We've fixed some bugs and made a few improvements:

The lake has been updated
Fishing has been added
The online shop bug has been fixed
We've added some lights to certain areas
A quest system has been added (currently in testing)

Thank you for your support, and we hope you enjoy the updates!

notes.title: HOTFİX V.0.1
notes.content:
Issues with the Casino and Market timing have been fixed.

The problem of being unable to pay bills has been resolved.

Text overflowing from certain edges has been corrected.

The bug related to purchasing weed has been fixed.

The slot machine issue has been addressed.

The error related to the box has been resolved.

A more detailed tutorial is planned for the next update.

Thank you, and enjoy the game!
